title: SKEIN_MODELS - the model menu for this deployment
description: The models an administrator can pick between in Settings. The operator sets this variable; the UI never writes it. Ids must be unique in the list (enforced by the server - JSON Schema cannot express unique-by-key). Any invalid entry voids the whole list, and the fault is reported on /health and the agent strip.

id.description: Model id exactly as the provider serves it. Must contain a non-space character - the server refuses a whitespace-only id.

label.description: Display name in the picker. Defaults to id.

detail.description: One line under the label - what this model is for.

max_tokens.description: Output token cap for this model. Defaults to SKEIN_MAX_TOKENS. Applied where SKEIN_MAX_TOKENS applies (anthropic, bedrock, ollama). The openai family refuses a generic cap - reasoning models return 400 - so there set the provider's own key in params instead.

context_tokens.description: Context capacity in tokens. Sets the SDK's context_window_limit for this model. Leave unset for models the SDK already knows - it resolves their capacity from its own table.

price.description: USD per million tokens. Wins over SKEIN_MODEL_PRICES for this id. cached_input is deliberately absent: usage accounting multiplies input and output only, and a price nothing multiplies is a believed number not in effect.

params.description: Provider pass-through (temperature, top_p, reasoning budgets, ...). Merged over SKEIN_MODEL_PARAMS - the per-model key wins.
